Accurate shared-device Lock/End Shift versus Transfer Command, and resolved queue before Logout; do not infer incident closure from session exit.

priority_capture.title: Schedule, reschedule and deliberately release a Dispatch call

fixture.name: TRAINING ONLY - scheduled coordination exercise
fixture.nature: Fictional Academy coordination request. No operational response.
fixture.recipient: One explicitly reviewed fictional Wallace Boden account; do not use Everyone or real recipients.
fixture.future_time: Choose an actual department-local time at least 15 minutes ahead when recording. Store its observed value and timezone, not a hard-coded old date.

required_shots: Console baseline with original active-call identities/count
Schedule Dispatch expanded with full future date/time and final Create button
Same call detail scheduled banner and full stored recipient
Reschedule entry and complete dialog with current department-local time
Changed preset or explicit future time before Save
Actual updated saved time and fresh reopening
Same call active/dispatched with stored recipient; queue absence alone is insufficient
Close own exercise with notification choice visible
Fresh unchanged original-call baseline after closure
source_facts: New call form enforces at least 15 minutes ahead.
Reschedule presets are In 1 hour, In 1 day, Tomorrow 8 AM.
Core UpdateScheduledDispatchTime interprets Date in department.TimeZone.
Scheduled Dispatch now uses stored recipients; Pending Dispatch opens an explicit recipient picker.
scope_limits: Do not claim timer-driven worker dispatch from manual Dispatch now.
Provider delivery requires its own receiver observation.
Read DOM and inspect pixels after each real UI transition; source labels below are capture expectations, not discovered browser locators.

Dispatch_and_IC_Records: record detail reads loaded.Values.Cells, while Core returns nested Sections/Rows/Cells.
Classification enum uses 1/2/3 instead of Core 0/1/2.

Before any record success narration, align only the isolated recording copies, run regression checks, reload an owned app server and capture actual normal-UI results. Do not weaken context/catalog/auth/ADP/offline gates.
Dispatch_archives: Calls/GetCallYears, GetArchivedCalls and SaveArchivedCall are client API references absent from checked Core controller tree. This is a bounded source observation, not a new runtime request.
